body:
Fixes #41437

## Problem

Required version for wasmtime is too strict, and doesn't match the bundled version

## Solution

Only require major version 36.

<details>
<summary>Old description</summary>

## Problem

1. The version detection regex for wasmtime doesn't match multi-digit minor or patch version segments, which means that the bundled version could not be detected correctly if the version has a multi-digit minor or patch.
2. The required version and bundled version don't match

## Solution

1. Add `+` to minor and patch version segments.
2. Update required version in `find_package` call.

Note: this is a "backport" of #41438

</details>

comment_data.body: This change needs to go in `master`, since we track LTS now (so this will eventually apply to every branch).
comment_data.diff_hunk:
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@ find_library2(WASMTIME_LIBRARY wasmtime)
 
 if(WASMTIME_INCLUDE_DIR AND EXISTS "${WASMTIME_INCLUDE_DIR}/wasmtime.h")
   file(STRINGS ${WASMTIME_INCLUDE_DIR}/wasmtime.h WASMTIME_VERSION REGEX "#define WASMTIME_VERSION")
-  string(REGEX MATCH "[0-9]+\.[0-9]\.[0-9]" WASMTIME_VERSION ${WASMTIME_VERSION})
+  string(REGEX MATCH "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+" WASMTIME_VERSION ${WASMTIME_VERSION})

comment_data.body: This should be changed to `36.0` (or just `36` as wasmtime doesn't do minor key); for an LTS, we don't need to require an exact patch version
comment_data.diff_hunk:
@@ -53,7 +53,7 @@ if(ENABLE_UNIBILIUM)
 endif()
 
 if(ENABLE_WASMTIME)
-  find_package(Wasmtime 36.0.6 EXACT REQUIRED)
+  find_package(Wasmtime 36.0.12 EXACT REQUIRED)

comment_regular_data.body: Review comments have been addressed. The only change now is changing the version from `36.0.6` to just `36`.
Thank you; I took the liberty of including this change in #41446. (I have never seen a .1 minor release from Wasmtime, but I wanted to match the format we use on master (48.0) for consistency.)
